text:
alex: Quick heads-up — PR #22345 (small optimizer backport) is green locally and passes unit tests. I want to fast-track it before the weekend deploy-freeze. Waiting on linux-integration job in CI, it's been flaky today.

maria: Can you paste the failing log?

alex: failing job is `ci/integration/linux-e2e` — intermittently timing out on `bench/end-to-end::large-batch`. Here's the last tail:
```
Error: Timeout waiting for batch to finish
  at tests/integration/large_batch.test.js:82:14
  stdout: "step 7/12 - worker stuck"
```

cheng: ugh that one has been noisy. I rolled a fix yesterday but didn't land it yet. If you rebase onto main@abcdef0 the test timeout is mitigated.

alex: OK I can rebase. Is there a rebase window today? We need to land before the freeze at 2026-03-20T00:00:00Z.

sam: There's a short rebase window at 11:30 UTC for quick fixes — try to make the patch tiny. cc @cheng for quick +1 on the test change. :eyes: 

alex: rebase done, pushed `alex/22345-rebased`. CI rerun started.

ci-bot: ci/integration/linux-e2e — queued

maria: Also need one code-owner approval from @cheng and an approval from platform owners for the optimization change (it's touching the scheduler).

cheng: Looking now. Two tiny comments about a timeout constant. I can approve once you switch to the new flag `SCHED_RETRY=3` rather than hardcoding 5000ms.

alex: done, pushed. small note in PR description about why SCHED_RETRY helps.

ci-bot: ci/integration/linux-e2e — running

alex: If this clears, can we land on canary channel first (manual canary to dedicated pool) rather than full prod? That gives us rollback safety while avoiding the freeze blockers.

sam: Yes, canary to dedicated pool is fine. Ops, please prep canary slot. @oncall-bot ping if latency spikes after deploy.

oncall-bot: Noted — will create a short alert window.

ci-bot: ci/integration/linux-e2e — passed :white_check_mark:

maria: :tada: Great. @cheng can you give the final +1 when you have a sec?

cheng: +1. ship it. :shipit:

alex: merging now — thanks all for quick turnaround. Leaving a rollback note in the PR and the canary runbook.

sam: Thanks — tagging this for the deploy-freeze exemption checklist so release team knows it's canary-only and short-lived.

alex: will follow up with a brief post-merge comment if anything weird shows up in canary metrics.

maria: perfect. appreciate the speed on this one.
